# VeraCruz

> VeraCruz is a senior design studio based in Brussels, Belgium. It takes on problems that cross product, service and physical design, and designs them as one project — from framing the problem to execution — with a small team of senior practitioners. Not to be confused with the Mexican city or state of Veracruz.

## What the studio does

- Product: digital products, apps and web, interaction design, design systems
- Service: customer journeys, service blueprints, operational flows, internal tooling
- Physical: product design, hardware, packaging, spaces and retail
- Approach: problem framing before craft; strategy and execution under one roof; senior, small team, no subcontracting chain; long-lasting work
- Confidentiality: much of the work is early-stage and pre-launch; client identities are kept private

## Who it works for

Mission-driven and established organisations. Sectors worked in: logistics, medical, telco, energy, banking.

## People

- Raphael Hombroeck — founder & principal designer, close to twenty years designing across product, service and physical: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rhombroeck/

## Services

- [AI Réputation](https://veracruz.be/ai-reputation/): measures how AI assistants perceive and present a brand, and improves it
